editorial:
Imagine being a powerful senator who has a secret, uncontrollable habit of grabbing women's bottoms. That is exactly the mess Senator Pupis finds himself in. He is a man of high status, but his urges are totally out of control, leading to some really awkward and funny situations. The vibe here is a wild, old-school Italian comedy that does not take itself too seriously. You will find yourself laughing at how desperate he gets to fix his problem, especially when he has to handle a state visit from a foreign leader without making a fool of himself. It is a weird, cheeky premise that keeps you guessing how far he will go to stay out of trouble.

What really makes this work is the silly acting and the fast pacing. While the humor is a bit dated, the physical comedy still hits the mark. If you like movies that are a bit naughty and very absurd, you will love this one. It is a great pick for a lazy weekend when you just want something light and strange. Since it is an older film, you should definitely look for a high-quality version.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with Pupis trying every possible cure, including help from the church. In the end, he realizes that his urges are just a part of who he is. Instead of a miracle cure, the story concludes with a funny realization about human nature and desire. He does not magically change, but the chaos he caused leads to a lighthearted finish where the absurdity of his condition is fully accepted by those around him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird vintage comedies and slapstick humor.
